# intrebit

> Solo software development agency based in the EU. Custom software, infrastructure, and consulting for startups and SMBs.

## About

intrebit is a one-person development agency. You work directly with the developer — no project managers, no handoffs, no layers. Architecture, code, infrastructure, and deployment, handled end to end.

Based in the EU. Data hosted in Germany. GDPR-compliant. Timezone-flexible for international clients.

## What Makes intrebit Different

- **Direct access.** You talk to the person writing the code. Every call, every decision.
- **Transparency.** No hidden costs, no vague timelines, no surprise invoices. You see what's being built and why.
- **Privacy-first.** EU-hosted, GDPR-compliant by default. We don't cut corners on data handling.
- **Small by choice.** Few clients at a time means focused attention, not stretched-thin delivery.

## Services

### Build
Custom software built for how you actually work. Web apps, internal tools, customer portals, mobile apps, marketing sites. From architecture through deployment.

### Fix
Broken systems, slow sites, inherited codebases. Root cause diagnosis and reliable fixes — not patches.

### Automate
Repetitive manual work turned into background processes. Data entry, report generation, invoice handling, system integrations.

## Tech Stack

Full-stack. Primary tools include:

- **Backend:** Rust, TypeScript, Node.js
- **Frontend:** React, Astro, HTML/CSS
- **Mobile:** Swift (iOS/macOS)
- **Infrastructure:** Cloudflare, Linux, Docker
- **Data:** PostgreSQL, SQLite

Comfortable picking up whatever a project requires.

## Ideal Client

- EU-based startups and SMBs
- Teams that need custom software but don't have (or want) an in-house dev team
- Founders who want to talk to the developer, not a sales rep

## Pricing

- Projects start at EUR 3,000
- Monthly retainers from EUR 2,000
- Scoped quotes provided before any work begins

## How We Work

1. Discovery call — understand the problem and goals
2. Scoped proposal — clear deliverables, timeline, and cost
3. Build — iterative delivery with regular check-ins
4. Handoff — full ownership of code and infrastructure transferred to you
